expectations.description: An image matching the prompt description must be generated and rendered on the canvas.
expectations.criteria: The canvas should show a group of adventurers in a tent.
expectations.success_condition: The image of adventurers in a tent is visible on the canvas.

expectations.description: Music from the 'desert adventure' playlist should start playing.
expectations.criteria: The background audio should transition from silent to playing atmospheric/desert adventure style music. The music status bar at the top of the screen should display the active playlist name 'desert adventure'.
expectations.success_condition: Desert adventure music is audible in the final output video, and the music status indicator updates to display 'desert adventure'.
